page.overview:
Who is Brian Spark?

Brian Spark is a character in Cars 3. He is a Piston Cup racer sponsored by Leak Less. He replaced Claude Scruggs from the first Cars film.

In Cars 3, he can be seen racing with Lightning McQueen and others. After the Los Angeles 500, Brian is replaced by George New-Win.thumb|He can be seen with Floyd and Cal.
